summary: This guide gives local retailers a 10-step process for moving into e-commerce and digital marketing, from strategic planning and platform choice through store development, inventory integration, payments, SEO, marketing, customer service and ongoing monitoring. It cites several named experts for specific advice and argues that digital adoption, increasingly common since September 2023, is now a necessity for staying competitive.
one_line: A 10-step guide for local retailers on launching and growing an e-commerce store using digital marketing, with advice from named experts.
key_facts: Since September of 2023, an increasing number of local retailers have embraced e-commerce and digital marketing to expand their customer base.
Jenna Gossington, a digital strategist working with small businesses since late 2023, advises retailers to understand target markets, set clear goals and define a unique value proposition.
E-commerce platform options mentioned include Shopify and WooCommerce; selection factors are cost, ease of use, customization options and scalability.
Chris Johnson, a web developer who has helped launch over 50 local retail sites since early 2024, emphasizes mobile optimization because many online shoppers use mobile devices.
Step 5 recommends integrating online and physical store inventory; modern POS systems like those introduced by Eric Tan in November of 2023 facilitate integration with e-commerce platforms.
Payment options to offer include credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and possibly cryptocurrencies.
Cybersecurity expert Maria Lopez stresses implementing SSL certificates and adhering to PCI Compliance to secure transactions and customer data.
SEO specialist Anthony Hughes advises local retailers to focus on long-tail keywords tied to local searches.
Mia Zhang, a digital marketer, increased local retail traffic by 120% since September 2023 and recommends user-generated content and customer testimonials.
Digital marketing channels listed are social media, email marketing, content marketing and pay-per-click advertising.
Customer service tips include chatbots, live chat during business hours, free shipping, easy returns and loyalty programs.
Step 10 advises using tools such as Google Analytics to track visitor behavior, conversion rates and overall sales, and adapting to customer feedback and market trends.
